_comment: mva-16: the Cloudflare Tunnel's real routing config previously lived only in Cloudflare's own dashboard, with no version-controlled source of truth anywhere on this machine or in any repo. This is a real, live export fetched directly from the Cloudflare API (GET /accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations) -- not hand-transcribed. Cloudflare's dashboard is still the actual control plane (editing this file does nothing on its own), so this needs to be re-exported after any real change there to stay accurate; it exists so a lost/corrupted machine, or anyone auditing this platform, has a real record of what the live routing currently is instead of nothing.
_change_note: 2026-09-19: registry-api.deskbusiness.co and market-api.deskbusiness.co removed on purpose so the backends are reachable only through the API Library (api.deskbusiness.co). They still run on localhost:3456 and 3457.
